question: In an Excel worksheet, the content of the active cell is displayed in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Formula bar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Formula Bar**

 
 
• In an **Excel worksheet**, the content of the **active cell is displayed in the formula bar**.
 
• Excel's formula bar is a unique toolbar **located at the top of the worksheet window that is marked with a function symbol (*fx*)**.
 
• It can be** used **to **display numerous lines for a single formula** and is used to **edit the content of any cell**.
 
• When working with a **lengthy formula**, the formula bar is really helpful since it allows us to examine the whole formula without covering the contents of the adjacent cells.
 
• The **equal sign** in any cell or a **click anywhere in the formula bar activates the bar**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Name Box**

 
 
• The **Name Box **in Excel refers to the **input box located immediately to the left of the formula bar**.
 
• The **address of the worksheet's "active cell"** is often shown in the Name Box. 
 
 
 
• **Title Bar**
 
 
• The **title bar is located above or next to the quick access toolbar** in the excel window. 
 
• It includes the** close, minimise, and maximise buttons** as well as the **window's title**.
 
 
 
• **Status Bar**
 
 
• The **lower edge of the worksheet window**, which shows **different data** about an Excel worksheet, is known as the **status bar**. 
 
• The** sum, count, and average** of the currently selected cells can be **displayed **in the **status bar**.
